results.title: 1970 Dodge Charger R/T 440 Six Pack
results.description: This 1970 Dodge Charger R/T is one of 337 examples that were built for the model year with a 440ci V8 topped by a trio of Holley two-barrel carburetors and linked with a three-speed automatic transmission. The car underwent a rotisserie refurbished around 2016 and is finished in Plum Crazy over white vinyl upholstery. Equipment includes a Sure Grip differential, body-color 15" steel wheels, hubcaps, hideaway headlamps, hood graphics, tail stripes, woodgrain interior trim, a center console, and courtesy lighting. Power steering and front disc brakes have been added. The seller purchased the vehicle in 2023, and the interior was reupholstered in 2025. This Charger 440 Six Pack is now offered with a broadcast sheet, refurbishment photos, removed black seat covers, a set of spare Magnum 500–style wheels, and transferable New York registration in the seller's name.
